sources.label: 2021 Legal Database
coverage: Master register (NOV 2021): case number, IIS reference, document date, respondent, address, contact person, violation flags, case handler, status and remarks.
No email, contact number, province, city/municipality, barangay, or document-type columns in the master register; document type is taken from the NOV type column.
Province derived from address; Negros Oriental and Siquijor cases excluded dashboard-wide.
Rows are retained even when the docs record column is blank.
No PAB NOV, orders, payments, complaints, LBC, or DPWH tabs in this workbook.

sources.label: 2022 Legal Database
coverage: Master register (NOV 2022): case number, IIS reference, document date, respondent, address, representative, violation flags, case handler, status and remarks.
No email, contact number, province, city/municipality, barangay, or document-type columns in the master register.
Province derived from address; Negros Oriental and Siquijor cases excluded dashboard-wide.
Rows are retained even when the docs record column is blank.
No PAB NOV, orders, payments, complaints, LBC, or DPWH tabs in this workbook.

sources.label: 2023 Legal Database
coverage: Master register (NOV 2023): case number, IIS reference, document date, respondent, address, proponent, violation flags, case handler.
No email, contact number, province, city/municipality, barangay, or document-type columns in the master register.
Province derived from address; Negros Oriental and Siquijor cases excluded dashboard-wide.
PAB notices (PAB NOV 2023) include penalty payment data embedded in the tab.
Orders/Resolutions 2023 tab split into regular orders and PAB orders.
ERF 2023 payments include province column.
Complaints tab (2023 only) with respondent address and location.
No LBC or DPWH tabs in this workbook.

sources.label: 2024 Legal Database
coverage: Master register (NOV 2024): case number, IIS reference, document date, respondent, address, proponent, violation flags, case handler, remarks.
No email, contact number, city/municipality, barangay, or document-type columns.
Province derived from address; Negros Oriental and Siquijor cases excluded dashboard-wide.
PAB 2024 notices; separate PAB PENALTY 2024 tab for penalties.
Orders/Resolutions 2024 tab split into regular orders and PAB orders.
ERF 2024 payments include province column.
DPWH Compliance 2024 (superseded by 2025 tab).
No LBC or Complaints tabs in this year.

sources.label: 2025 Legal Database
coverage: Master register: case number, IIS reference, document date, respondent, address, proponent, violation flags, case handler.
No email, contact number, province, city/municipality, barangay, or document-type columns in the master register.
Province is derived only when Cebu, Bohol, Negros Oriental, or Siquijor is explicit in the address; city/municipality stays blank.
Includes Document Tracking (LBC) and DPWH Compliance tabs, which are not present in the 2026 workbook.
Negros Oriental and Siquijor cases excluded dashboard-wide.

sources.label: 2026 Legal Database
coverage: Master register includes province, city/municipality, barangay, document type, case handler, and notes.
Includes Complaints and NO NOV - TC ONLY tabs.
Does not include Document Tracking (LBC) or DPWH Compliance.
Negros Oriental and Siquijor cases excluded dashboard-wide.
